screen: G5 exact-coordinate excess-stack covariate after fixed provided commercial-footprint exclusion; descriptive-only

measure_before.G5_definition: exact lon/lat coordinate stack; at least five distinct nonempty normalized primary names; Est feature is stacked places in tract / all eligible assigned places in tract

method.outcome: Frozen S1 orthogonalized establishment/facility disagreement cross-fit residual; no labels or refit.
method.feature: Existing G5 Est|covariate exact-coordinate distinct-name stack share. Filtered variant removes all provided eligible POI points whose exact coordinates are covered by at least one qualifying provided large commercial building footprint, then recomputes the identical G5 numerator and denominator on the remaining points.

footprint_rule.sources: Only provided Overture building records whose source memberships are exclusively OpenStreetMap/OSM/Esri; mixed or Microsoft membership rows are rejected before geometry decode.
footprint_rule.class: whole-word class token: commercial, industrial, warehouse, retail, shopping, or mall

method.G5_stack_rule: Reuse the exact G5 coordinate key from original POI lon/lat and normalized primary-name rule; qualifying stack has at least five distinct nonempty primary names. No altered distance, fuzzy-coordinate, or alternate-name rule.
method.validation: For each official region, hold out each supported five-digit GEOID county as a fixed leave-one-county-out fold. Fit separate one-term residual corrections for unfiltered and filtered features on identical paired support.
method.standardization: For each fold and each feature, use training-county mean and population SD only; predict held-out county with training-fitted intercept and coefficient. Zero SD uses scale 1.
method.metric: Pooled and regional county-held-out incremental ΔR²=(zero-correction frozen-S1 SSE - OOF corrected SSE)/zero-correction SSE. Paired county-block bootstrap within official regions.
method.comparisons: Unfiltered and filtered models share identical outer folds and paired support. The filtered-versus-unfiltered ΔR² difference is reported separately.
method.interpretation_limit: Feature screen only; not target accuracy, causal inference, or estimator-promotion evidence.

paired_county_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-out county SSE blocks sampled with replacement within each official region
